chief_data.selection_rationale: Candidate 1 is selected with a combined score of 0.690. It is the only candidate meeting the minimum conversion requirement, achieving a 3.0x residence-time reduction over batch. The safety score of 0.920 is the highest among all candidates, ensuring a robust design. The runner-ups were disqualified due to insufficient conversion, which is critical for the reaction's success. The user objective of balanced performance influenced the decision, prioritizing safety and conversion. The most important remaining uncertainty is the kinetic enhancement factor, which should be verified experimentally. The first experiment should verify the conversion at the specified residence time.
remaining_uncertainties: k estimated from batch; flow enhancement factor of 10× is class-typical but not experimentally verified
chief_data.experiment_recommendation: Run blank solvent at design Q for 30 min, then switch to reaction mixture. Sample at t=3τ and t=5τ.
